translations.web: “Therefore sigh, you son of man. You shall sigh before their eyes with a broken heart and with bitterness.
translations.bsb: But you, son of man, groan! Groan before their eyes with a broken heart and bitter grief.
translations.kjv: Sigh therefore, thou son of man, with the breaking of thy loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.
translations.asv: Sigh therefore, thou son of man; with the breaking of thy loins and with bitterness shalt thou sigh before their eyes.
